<!--
  ml.albertprofe.dev long-scroll landing.
  Modelled on albertprofe.dev index.qmd (structure, theme tokens, cards, start-here path).
  Cinematic hero uses images/landing/hero-ml.jpg (dark) and hero-ml-light.jpg (light).
  Numbers counted from this repo on 10 November 2026 (Europe/Madrid):
    - 71 .qmd pages -> find . -name '*.qmd' (includes 404, outlines, and this landing)
    - 23 commits on master, 28 December 2024 to 5 January 2025
    - 14 Helsinki Python MOOC parts (plus python-index.qmd)
    - 4 ANN articles (introduction, mathematical, index, relocated home)
    - 9 classic algorithm sketches + algo-index.qmd
    - 6 annotated external labs on labs/labs-index.qmd
  Many of the 71 pages are short outlines written this session so every
  agreed section has a home, Labs and Resources. Do not read 71 as 71 finished articles.
-->

      <a class="lp-step" href="algorithms/algo-linear-regression.html"><div class="lp-step-num">2</div><div><h3>A first algorithm</h3><p class="lp-muted">Linear regression — still a short definition page, and the seed for the other classic algorithms.</p></div></a>

<script>
(function () {
  // hero orbit: chips travel on a tilted ellipse around teacher and student; front = bigger and brighter
  (function () {
    var box = document.getElementById('lp-orbit'); if (!box) return;
    var chips = box.querySelectorAll('.lp-chip'), n = chips.length, t0 = performance.now(), raf = 0;
    var mq = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') : null;
    var RETURN_MS = 750;
    var st = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) st[i] = { frozen: false, fromX: 0, fromY: 0, fromS: 1, fromO: 1, returnStart: 0 };
    function readPose(c) {
      var tr = c.style.transform || '';
      var m = tr.match(/translate\(([-\d.]+)px,\s*([-\d.]+)px\)\s*scale\(([-\d.]+)\)/);
      return {
        x: m ? parseFloat(m[1]) : 0,
        y: m ? parseFloat(m[2]) : 0,
        s: m ? parseFloat(m[3]) : 1,
        o: parseFloat(c.style.opacity || '1')
      };
    }
    function freeze(i) {
      var pose = readPose(chips[i]);
      st[i].frozen = true;
      st[i].fromX = pose.x; st[i].fromY = pose.y; st[i].fromS = pose.s; st[i].fromO = pose.o;
      st[i].returnStart = 0;
    }
    function unfreeze(i, now) {
      if (!st[i].frozen && !st[i].returnStart) return;
      var pose = readPose(chips[i]);
      st[i].frozen = false;
      st[i].fromX = pose.x; st[i].fromY = pose.y; st[i].fromS = pose.s; st[i].fromO = pose.o;
      st[i].returnStart = (mq && mq.matches) ? 0 : now;
    }
    chips.forEach(function (c, i) {
      c.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { freeze(i); });
      c.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { unfreeze(i, performance.now()); });
      c.addEventListener('focus', function () { freeze(i); });
      c.addEventListener('blur', function () { unfreeze(i, performance.now()); });
    });
    function easeOutCubic(u) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - u, 3); }
    function place(now) {
      var W = box.clientWidth, H = box.clientHeight, narrow = W < 900;
      var cx = W * (narrow ? .62 : .64), cy = H * .52, rx = W * (narrow ? .33 : .27), ry = H * (narrow ? .30 : .26), tilt = -0.18;
      var t = (now - t0) / 1000 * 0.16;
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        var c = chips[i], s = st[i];
        var a = t + i * 2 * Math.PI / n, x = Math.cos(a) * rx, y = Math.sin(a) * ry;
        var X = cx + x * Math.cos(tilt) - y * Math.sin(tilt), Y = cy + x * Math.sin(tilt) + y * Math.cos(tilt);
        var depth = (Math.sin(a) + 1) / 2;
        var liveX = X - c.offsetWidth / 2, liveY = Y - c.offsetHeight / 2;
        var liveS = 0.78 + depth * 0.32, liveO = 0.45 + depth * 0.55;
        if (s.frozen) {
          c.style.zIndex = 5;
          continue;
        }
        if (s.returnStart) {
          var u = (now - s.returnStart) / RETURN_MS;
          if (u >= 1) { s.returnStart = 0; u = 1; }
          else u = easeOutCubic(Math.max(0, u));
          var ix = s.fromX + (liveX - s.fromX) * u;
          var iy = s.fromY + (liveY - s.fromY) * u;
          var isc = s.fromS + (liveS - s.fromS) * u;
          var io = s.fromO + (liveO - s.fromO) * u;
          c.style.transform = 'translate(' + ix.toFixed(1) + 'px,' + iy.toFixed(1) + 'px) scale(' + isc.toFixed(3) + ')';
          c.style.opacity = io.toFixed(2);
          c.style.zIndex = 4;
          continue;
        }
        c.style.transform = 'translate(' + liveX.toFixed(1) + 'px,' + liveY.toFixed(1) + 'px) scale(' + liveS.toFixed(3) + ')';
        c.style.opacity = liveO.toFixed(2);
        c.style.zIndex = depth > .5 ? 3 : 1;
      }
    }
    function loop(now) { place(now); raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    function start() {
      if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
      if ((mq && mq.matches) || document.hidden) { place(t0); return; }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
    start();
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { place(performance.now()); });
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', start);
    if (mq && mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', start);
  })();

  var tbtn = document.getElementById('lp-theme');
  if (tbtn) tbtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (typeof window.quartoToggleColorScheme === 'function') { window.quartoToggleColorScheme(); return; }
    var dark = !document.body.classList.contains('quarto-dark');
    try { window.localStorage.setItem('quarto-color-scheme', dark ? 'alternate' : 'default'); } catch (e) {}
    document.body.classList.toggle('quarto-dark', dark);
    document.body.classList.toggle('quarto-light', !dark);
  });
  var mbtn = document.getElementById('lp-menu-btn'), mnav = document.getElementById('lp-nav');
  function lpMenu(open) { mnav.classList.toggle('lp-open', open); mbtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false'); mbtn.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'); }
  if (mbtn && mnav) {
    mbtn.addEventListener('click', function () { lpMenu(mbtn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true'); });
    mnav.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target.closest('a') && !e.target.closest('.lp-dd-menu')) lpMenu(false); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape' && mbtn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') { lpMenu(false); mbtn.focus(); } });
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('.lp-header')) lpMenu(false); });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { if (window.innerWidth > 760) lpMenu(false); });
  }
  var tdd = document.getElementById('lp-topics-dd'), topicsBtn = document.getElementById('lp-topics-btn');
  function lpTopics(open) {
    if (!tdd || !topicsBtn) return;
    tdd.classList.toggle('open', open);
    topicsBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  }
  if (tdd && topicsBtn) {
    topicsBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); lpTopics(topicsBtn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true'); });
    tdd.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target.closest('a')) { lpTopics(false); if (mbtn && window.innerWidth <= 760) lpMenu(false); } });
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#lp-topics-dd')) lpTopics(false); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') lpTopics(false); });
  }
  var words = ['ANN','PYTHON','TRANSFORMER','LLM','RAG','PERCEPTRON','GRADIENT','ATTENTION'];
  var spin = document.getElementById('lp-spin'), k = 0;
  if (spin) setInterval(function () { spin.style.opacity = 0; setTimeout(function () { k = (k + 1) % words.length; spin.textContent = words[k]; spin.style.opacity = 1; }, 250); }, 1600);
  var els = document.querySelectorAll('#lp .lp-reveal');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) { es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('lp-in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } }); }, { threshold: 0.12 });
    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else { els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('lp-in'); }); }
})();
</script>
